title: Estimates towards the Riemann hypothesis
question: Can stronger moment estimates improve the proposed zero-free boundary $7/8$ or prove that at least $68\%$ of the nontrivial zeta zeros are simple and on the critical line?
summary: Two analytic targets replace a broad proof-audit agenda: extend the marked fourth-moment estimate below its stated parameter range and rework the resulting zero-free region; find and prove one-sided higher-moment inequalities sufficient for a 68% proportion of simple critical-line zeros. The recent papers supply starting arguments, with their required inputs explicitly subject to verification.
